text.description_html:
Omnia 9130/25, 1 Inch Solid Brass Sunflower Cabinet Knob

This cheery cabinet knob is sure to brighten up any home. From the sunflower in the knob to the ridges along the handle, every detail adds a charming rural accent. This pull is not just for kitchen cabinets ether. Try using it in the bathroom or on sliding accordion closet doors too! The sunflower cabinet knob is made from solid brass.

Specifications of the Flower Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Brass
  • Finish: Shaded Bronze
  • Diameter: 1"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.
